surface_mechanism_description: Half of the ligands are released during the Ti(OCH(CH3)2)4 pulse in reactions with the surface hydroxyl groups, and the other half during the D2O pulse, converting the surface back to being hydroxyl group terminated.
evidence: In the Ti(OCH(CH3)2)4–D2O ALD process, the reaction mechanism was studied using QMS and QCM. The authors found that half of the ligands were released during the titanium precursor pulse in reactions with surface hydroxyl groups, and the other half during the D2O pulse, converting the surface back to being hydroxyl group terminated.
